🎂 Birthday Checker
Paste any 5-digit numbers and see which ones can form a valid birthday date using their digits in any arrangement.

🔵 Blue = seen before (drawn all-time, not this month)
⬜ Gray = never drawn in entire dataset
🔥 = drawn this month · Red ✕ = remove tile

🔍 Pattern Origin

i
🔍 Pattern Origin
Select a pattern type (All, S, D, DD, T, TD, Q) and optionally a state. The drill-down shows all historical draws of that pattern, cross-referenced against your global filter scope.
Year tiles — each year's count reflects how many global filter draws share a sorted value with that year's historical draws. Click to drill down.
Month tiles — same logic, scoped to months within the selected year. Count = FILT matches. Days shown = only days with at least 1 match.
Day tiles — count = how many FILT draws match sorted values from that historical day. Click to see the rows.
Numbers view — shows each historical draw on the left, with the matching FILT draw (date + number) on the right. If a sorted value hit multiple times in your filter, it appears as a separate row each time. Click See all draws this day to view every draw from that date.

📅 Consecutive Historical Date Tracker

i
📅 Consecutive Historical Date Tracker
Tracks when a state draws numbers on consecutive current days that both reference the same historical month/year — with consecutive day numbers in that historical month.
Example: OH drew on Apr 9 → matched Mar 2020 day 9. OH drew on Apr 10 → matched Mar 2020 day 10. That's a streak.
Each row shows the two numbers, the current dates they were drawn, and the historical month/year they each referenced.
⚠️ = state is overdue based on 1.5× its average gap between streaks.
Tracks when a state draws numbers referencing consecutive days of the same historical month/year. e.g. OH drew from Mar 2020 day 9 on Apr 9, then Mar 2020 day 10 on Apr 10.

🔗 Convergence Tracker

i
🔗 Convergence Tracker
Tracks sorted values that have been drawn by multiple states within a configurable time window — revealing numbers that are "traveling" across states.
Window — how many days to look back for a cluster. Same Day = exact same date. 7 Days = within a week.
Min States — minimum number of distinct states required for a convergence hit.
🚀 Active Now — sorted values with a cluster in the last 3 days.
Scope — Filter uses your global date filter. All Time searches all data.

🔢 Digit Session Tracker

i
🔢 Digit Session Tracker
Select a date and draw (midday/evening/both) to analyze the digit distribution of that session vs the all-time historical baseline.
Digit grid — each digit shows its count, percentage, baseline %, and delta. Red = suppressed (≤1x). Blue = elevated (≥7x).
Evening Rebound Model — finds all historical midday sessions with the same digit suppression pattern and shows what their evenings looked like, including pattern rates and expected digit rebounds.
Similar Sessions — all historical sessions ranked by digit-profile cosine similarity. Click any row to see full draws for that day.

⏳ Gap Analysis

i
⏳ How Gap Analysis Works
A gap is the number of draws since a digit, pair, or sorted number last appeared. Higher gap = more overdue.
📊 Modes
Digit Gaps — How long since each digit (0–9) last appeared anywhere in a draw. Sorted by gap descending.
Pair Gaps — How long since each 2-digit pair last appeared together in a draw.
By Position — How long since each digit last appeared at each specific position (1–5). Used to generate picks.
🎯 Position-Based Picks
Standard (10) — Built from the most overdue digit at each position, cycled across combinations.
Extended (5) — Same overdue digits but constrained to target trending sums.
Seen Before (5) — Mix of overdue + most frequent digits, filtered to only combos drawn at least once all-time.
🔁 Recurring Hits
Numbers the algorithm generated on 2+ different days in the selected window. The more days, the stronger the signal. Click any tile to see exact arrangements.
Straight Repeaters — Same exact number (not just sorted) generated on 2+ days.
🎨 Tile Colors
Standard — not yet hit
T / TD / Q / Qu pattern — priority
🎯 Straight hit — exact number drawn
📦 Boxed hit — same digits, different order
🔍 Back Test (By Position only)
Set a cutoff date to simulate what the algorithm would have generated using only data available up to that point. Draws after the cutoff are used to score hits.

🧪 Backtest Scoring

Test strategies against historical data
i
🧪 How Backtest Works
1. Set a date range — data before start = training, data in range = test window.
2. Pick strategies — each strategy generates picks daily using only data available up to that day (rolling simulation).
3. Check hits — each day picks are compared to actual draws. 🎯 Straight = exact number. 📦 Boxed = same digits, different order.
Hit Rate = scored hits ÷ total draws × 100%
Avg Draws/Hit = average draws between consecutive hits.
✓ in picks detail = number was in the pick list AND drawn that day. Grey = generated but did not hit on a day it was picked.
🎯 Consensus Picks — numbers appearing in 2+ strategies. Filter by 2+/3+/4+/5+. Blue border = also a scored hit. More strategies agreeing = stronger signal.
Strategies
📊 Frequency — top 20 most drawn in your selected state/filter training data
Σ Delta ≤2 — numbers with |sum−count| ≤ 2 and 3+ draws
EΔ=0 — next draw would make sum = count exactly
🔥 Top Sums — most drawn numbers from the top 5 sums
⏳ Gap Analysis — 10 picks from most overdue digits per position, regenerated daily. Scored straight + boxed
📐 Pattern — top 20 most drawn of your selected pattern type (S/D/DD/T/TD/Q/Qu)
🔢 Total Drawn (All States) — top 20 most drawn across ALL states regardless of filter
⏰ Overdue — longest gap since last draw, minimum 5 all-time draws
🔥 Hot Streak — drawn 2+ times in the 30 days before the start date
